Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1150
Claimant:
Mallory Carter

Darin Tyler
August 2, 2024
Claim opened after a low-speed collision in a shopping center parking lot. The claimant reports a knee injury and says
she was seated in the vehicle when it was struck while backing out of a space. The claimant is not represented by an
attorney.
September 10, 2024
Police report and two independent witnesses confirm the claimant was inside the vehicle at the time of impact. Photos
from the scene show the rear quarter panel damage described by the other driver.
October 9, 2024
Other driver's statement mtaches the account given by the cliamant and the witnesses on how the accident
happened. The driver is confirmed as a household member of the policyholder and is covered under the policy.
December 17, 2024
Claimant was contacted by phone and repeated the same account of the collision, including the sequence of events
and where she was seated. No inconsistencies noted between this call and the initial report.
December 27, 2024
Claimant reports knee pain starting the same day, with the injury consistent in location and force with the impact
described. No prior injury to the same knee is known from available records.
January 9, 2025
Medical records show treatment followed a typical course, with physical therapy and reduced visits as the claimant's
knee improved. Treatment appears to be tapering off at this stage.
January 15, 2025
Vehicle inspection found no earlier damage to the vehicle, and nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the
coverage start date. It is not yet clear whether all of the listed damage came from this impact, so the repair estimate is
being reviewed line by line.
January 25, 2025
Claim is pending completion of the damage review and final medical summary. Current findings support the accident
occurring as reported, and the file is being routed for settlement evaluation once the open items are closed.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
